what: Title cut by bytes ends in half a letter; the screen then prints nothing for the title (register and page). Known DEF-QUA-017 (pack 17 B7, "B ok") still present; the effect is worse than "stored broken": the whole title vanishes.
rule: Pack 17 B7 DEF-QUA-017 (owner "B ok")

what: Double submit of Raise it creates two numbered nonconformities. Same family as pack 17 B14 (owner "B ok") for management reviews.
rule: Pack 17 B14 family (owner "B ok"): a double press must not open two numbered records

what: Nonconformities raised without picking a branch get no branch; the register treats them as Ahmedabad. A Mumbai user loses their own record and Ahmedabad sees it. Same blank branch on confidentiality-breach nonconformities.
rule: lib/ncr.php header rule 4 "It belongs to a branch … scoped from the first query"; form label "— from the job, or mine —"

what: An owner typed as a name (allowed by the form) gets a reminder addressed to the name itself, which can never arrive.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/ncr.php ncr_run_reminders() → ops_mail($owner…)

what: Known DEF-QUA-016 still present: empty Owner and date erases the due date.
rule: Pack 17 B5 DEF-QUA-016 (owner "B ok")

what: Containment, disposition and owner/date can be changed on a CLOSED nonconformity (old tab or direct request); the handlers never check the status.
rule: Closed nonconformity is final until reopened by whoever may close (docs/02 20a, R3)

what: A closed nonconformity can be closed again; the close note and date are overwritten.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/ncr.php ncr-close (no status check)

what: Reopen on a not-closed nonconformity moves it to "Disposition agreed" with no disposition, so the register shows it past a step it never took.
rule: Reopen "undoes a closure" (lib/ncr.php); status order Open → Contained → Disposition agreed → Closed

what: Nonconformity pages are not branch-checked: another branch can open, assign, classify and open a CAPA on a record its own register hides.
rule: Register is branch-scoped (scope_clause); object pages must apply the same scope (cmp_scope_gate pattern, M14)

what: Known DEF-QUA-007 (pack 17 B11, "B ok") still present: two history panels on one nonconformity.
rule: Pack 17 B11 DEF-QUA-007 (owner "B ok")

what: Known DEF-QUA-009 (pack 17 B3, "B ok") still present: the complaint and client are dropped when the form is saved.
rule: Pack 17 B3 DEF-QUA-009 (owner "B ok")

what: Departure "created by" and extension "approved by" store the login name (test.qualityhead, test.branchmgr) instead of the display name used everywhere else (Test QualityHead).
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/ncdca.php ncdca_departure_ref()

what: Unknown status still says "Departure updated."; an odd kind gives "Whatever DEV-2026-0002 created." Wording reports success that did not happen.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/ncdca.php ncdca_departure_set_status(); pack 17 A9

what: departure-status redirects to whatever "back" address is posted, including an outside website (open redirect).
rule: The app redirects only to its own pages (redirect_back same-host rule in lib/helpers.php)

what: Dispute & response has no Decide button, so a dispute stays "open" for ever; meanwhile a hidden request lets a Branch Manager decide (and re-decide) it.
rule: Every action must have its button (UI blueprint, Zero Training UI); R3 principle for deciding

what: extension-approve has no "may close" check and no button: a Branch Manager can approve his own extension by a direct request, which issue-extend deliberately prevents.
rule: issue-extend: only ncr_can_close() may approve; R3 decisions go to closers

what: An extension with a blank date erases the nonconformity's due date; earlier and past dates are accepted as "extensions".
rule: Extension keeps the original and moves the due date forward (lib/ncdca.php §32)

what: "Done" on an action that is already done is accepted and logged again; the action is not checked to belong to the CAPA whose page sent it.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/capa.php capa_action_done/cancel/reopen

what: The refusal for closing a CAPA talks about "archive" and an "Archive" tick, which the screen never calls it (the button says Close).
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: docs/02 CAPA Close; lib/capa.php capa-close; lib/ops.php perm_route_verb capa-close=archive

what: Plan, cause and effectiveness of a CLOSED CAPA can be changed, and it can be closed again; a closed "verified effective" CAPA can end up saying "did not work".
rule: Closed CAPA = verified effective and final (lib/capa.php §8.7.3)

what: capa-escalate closes the CAPA (as failed) with no close-permission check, and a second press opens another successor CAPA.
rule: docs/02: CAPA BM/OM Edit, Close = QH/TH (capa.close)

what: Known DEF-QUA-005 (pack 17 B2, "B ok") still present: CAPA deadline settings never save, and no message says so.
rule: Pack 17 B2 DEF-QUA-005 (owner "B ok")

what: CAPA and complaint overdue mails are sent with an empty To address, so ops_mail() never sends them (error "no recipient") — on the live site too. The Quality Head is also not among the recipients.
rule: cron.php runs capa_run_reminders/cmp_run_reminders to chase overdue items; ops_mail() needs a To address

what: capa-from-complaint does not check the complaint was upheld: a CAPA can be raised on an undecided complaint by a direct request.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/capa.php capa-from-complaint (no outcome check)

what: Outcome and CAPA reference of a CLOSED complaint can be changed from an old tab or direct request; the record then fails its own close gate while still Closed.
rule: Closed complaint passes cmp_close_missing(); must not change after close

what: Deadlock for "Not ours": closing needs the complainant told, telling needs an outcome, and the outcome is not required for "Not ours" and can only be set by the decide right.
rule: cmp_close_missing() does not require an outcome for NOT_OURS, but complaint-notify does

what: Known DEF-QUA-001 (pack 17 B1, "B ok") still present: complaint deadlines and the published description never save, silently.
rule: Pack 17 B1 DEF-QUA-001 (owner "B ok")

what: Double submit creates two numbered complaints (same family as pack 17 B14).
rule: Pack 17 B14 family (owner "B ok")

what: A declaration with no person is accepted by a direct request ("Declaration recorded.").
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/impartiality.php imp-declare

what: An undertaking signed in the future is shown as "Lapsed", which tells the reader it ran out rather than that it has not started.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/confidentiality.php conf_undertaking_live(), conf_coverage()

what: Obligation end for a month-end date overflows: 31 Jan 2027 + 1 month is shown as 03 Mar 2027 instead of 28 Feb 2027 (also 31 Aug + 1 month → 1 Oct, etc.).
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/confidentiality.php conf_nda_obligation_ends() strtotime(+N months)

what: Containment written on the breach after it was raised never reaches its nonconformity; the Quality Head has to type it again.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/confidentiality.php conf-breach POST

what: The breach form saves on a CLOSED breach from an old tab; "party told" can be blanked after closing.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/confidentiality.php conf-breach POST (no status check)

what: Save on a failure row erases its CAPA reference (the form has no CAPA box, the handler writes it blank), so the failure cannot resolve and a duplicate CAPA gets raised.
rule: failure_close_missing(): data affected YES needs its CAPA reference

what: A resolved failure can be edited back to "not answered" while staying resolved, and a typed CAPA reference that does not exist satisfies the gate.
rule: Expected behaviour stated in the case; basis: lib/datacontrol.php failure-update (no status check)
